hello-sunshine.com; Los Angeles media company founded 2016 by Reese Witherspoon. Otter Media (AT&T/WarnerMedia) already held a stake, and in Feb 2019 Emerson Collective invested while Otter increased its stake - amounts and round type not disclosed. Aug 2021: majority stake acquired by Candle Media (Kevin Mayer/Tom Staggs, backed by Blackstone) in a deal valuing it at ~ $900M, buying out Otter Media and Emerson Collective.

theathletic.com (now nytimes.com/athletic); founded 2016 in San Francisco (YC-backed). Series B $20M (Mar 2018, Evolution Media), Series C $40M (Oct 2018, Founders Fund & Bedrock), Series D $50M (Jan 2020, Bedrock; ~ $500M valuation; Emerson Collective participated). Axios reported $139.5M total raised since 2016 (used as amount_raised; seed/Series A not itemized). Acquired by The New York Times Company for $550M cash (announced Jan 6, 2022; closed Q1 2022).
